Comment: CONFORMANCE NOTE: MHSTDTC and MHDTC contain values of mixed ISO 8601 precision across the two source datasets. TCGA-BRCA values are year-only (YYYY) for MHSTDTC and date-only (YYYY-MM-DD) for MHDTC. MIMIC-IV values are full datetimes (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS) for both. Both columns are declared as DataType incompleteDatetime to accommodate both. Downstream analysis should account for this precision difference when comparing across studies.
MHCAT values differ by study: TCGA-BRCA uses 'TCGA-PATIENT'; MIMICIVBC uses 'MALIGNANCY HISTORY'. Both are sponsor-defined, non-CDISC-CT values. See codelist CL.MHCAT.COMBINED.

Name: Algorithm to derive MHTERM (combined TCGA+MIMIC)
Description: SOURCE DEPENDENT BY STUDYID. TCGA-BRCA (385 rows): Source = histological_type + histologic_diagnosis_other (nationwidechildrens_org_clinical_patient_brca.txt). Rule: if histological_type == 'Other  specify', MHTERM = 'Other specify - ' || histologic_diagnosis_other. If histological_type == 'Mixed Histology (please specify)', MHTERM = 'Mixed Histology (please specify) - ' || histologic_diagnosis_other. Otherwise MHTERM = histological_type verbatim. MIMICIVBC (9 rows): Source = MHTERM column in MH.xlsx (pre-mapped). Value is an ICD code string (e.g. 'C50919'), direct copy.

Name: Algorithm to derive MHDECOD (combined TCGA+MIMIC)
Description: SOURCE DEPENDENT BY STUDYID. TCGA-BRCA (385 rows): Source = icd_o_3_histology code (e.g. '8500/3') from nationwidechildrens_org_clinical_patient_brca.txt. Mapped to text description via icd-o-3_code_to_text.xlsx lookup (13 codes, complete cohort coverage). NOTE: 4 subjects have MHTERM/MHDECOD mismatch — see discrepancy report (TCGA-BH-A0HL, TCGA-EW-A1OW, TCGA-EW-A1OX, TCGA-EW-A1PE). MIMICIVBC (9 rows): Source = MHDECOD column in MH.xlsx (pre-mapped). Value is ICD description text, direct copy.
FormalExpression:
# TCGA
if STUDYID == 'TCGA-BRCA':
    lookup = pd.read_excel('icd-o-3_code_to_text.xlsx')
             .set_index('icd_o_3_code')['icd_o_3_text']
    MHDECOD = icd_o_3_histology.map(lookup)
# MIMIC
elif STUDYID == 'MIMICIVBC':
    MHDECOD = MH_xlsx.MHDECOD  # direct copy

Name: Algorithm to derive MHSTDTC (combined TCGA+MIMIC)
Description: SOURCE AND FORMAT DEPENDENT BY STUDYID. TCGA-BRCA (385 rows): Source = initial_pathologic_dx_year. If 4-digit year (regex ^\d{4}$), assign as-is (year-only ISO 8601). If sentinel '[Not Available]', MHSTDTC is blank. Result DataType: partialDate (YYYY). 2 subjects have blank MHSTDTC. MIMICIVBC (9 rows): Source = MHSTDTC column in MH.xlsx (pre-mapped). Value is full ISO 8601 datetime (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS), direct copy. NOTE — CONFORMANCE GAP: MHSTDTC values differ in precision across studies (year-only for TCGA vs full datetime for MIMIC). The combined column cannot be declared with a single DataType that satisfies both.
FormalExpression:
# TCGA
if STUDYID == 'TCGA-BRCA':
    is_year = initial_pathologic_dx_year.str.match(r'^\d{4}$', na=False)
    MHSTDTC = initial_pathologic_dx_year.where(is_year, '')
# MIMIC
elif STUDYID == 'MIMICIVBC':
    MHSTDTC = MH_xlsx.MHSTDTC  # direct copy ISO8601 datetime

Name: Algorithm to derive MHDTC (combined TCGA+MIMIC)
Description: SOURCE AND FORMAT DEPENDENT BY STUDYID. TCGA-BRCA (385 rows): Source = form_completion_date (format YYYY-M-D). Reformatted to zero-padded ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD via pd.to_datetime. Represents BCR form completion date, NOT the event date. MIMICIVBC (9 rows): Source = MHDTC column in MH.xlsx (pre-mapped). Value is full ISO 8601 datetime (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS), direct copy. NOTE — CONFORMANCE GAP: MHDTC values differ in precision across studies (date-only YYYY-MM-DD for TCGA vs full datetime for MIMIC). The combined column cannot be declared with a single DataType.
FormalExpression:
# TCGA
if STUDYID == 'TCGA-BRCA':
    MHDTC = pd.to_datetime(form_completion_date, errors='coerce')
            .dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d').fillna('')
# MIMIC
elif STUDYID == 'MIMICIVBC':
    MHDTC = MH_xlsx.MHDTC  # direct copy ISO8601 datetime

Name: Algorithm to derive MHSTDY (TCGA-BRCA only)
Description: TCGA-BRCA ONLY. MHSTDY is blank for all MIMICIVBC rows. Source = days_to_initial_pathologic_diagnosis from nationwidechildrens_org_clinical_patient_brca.txt. Rule: MHSTDY = days_to_initial_pathologic_diagnosis + 1. In TCGA-BRCA, source = 0 for all 385 cohort subjects, so MHSTDY = 1 for all.

Name: Algorithm to derive MHSTRTPT and MHSTTPT (TCGA-BRCA only)
Description: TCGA-BRCA ONLY. Both MHSTRTPT and MHSTTPT are blank for all MIMICIVBC rows. Source = initial_pathologic_dx_year from nationwidechildrens_org_clinical_patient_brca.txt. Rule: populated iff source == '[Not Available]' (exact, case-sensitive). When triggered: MHSTRTPT = 'BEFORE', MHSTTPT = 'SCREENING'. 2 TCGA subjects trigger the condition (TCGA-HN-A2NL, TCGA-HN-A2OB).

Name: Algorithm for MIMIC direct-copy variables
Description: MIMICIVBC ONLY. For MIMIC rows, the following variables are direct copies from the pre-mapped MH.xlsx source file with no transformation: USUBJID, MHSEQ, MHCAT, MHOCCUR, MHSTAT, MHDY, VISITNUM, VISIT, MHEVDTYP. MHTERM and MHDECOD are also direct copies for MIMIC (see MT.COMBINED.MHTERM and MT.COMBINED.MHDECOD). NOTE — SPEC GAP: The MH.xlsx file is itself a pre-mapped SDTM output, not raw RWD. True RWD lineage for MIMIC would require tracing back to the MIMIC-IV PostgreSQL database (tables: hosp.diagnoses_icd, hosp.admissions, etc.). That level of traceability is not represented in this lineage file.
FormalExpression:
if STUDYID == 'MIMICIVBC':
    <variable> = MH_xlsx.<variable>  # direct copy, no transformation
